text: OVERDOSAGE: There have been no reports of overdosage with fluorouracil cream. The oral LD 50 for the 5% topical cream was 234 mg/kg in rats and 39 mg/kg in dogs. These doses represented 11.7 and 1.95 mg/kg of fluorouracil, respectively. The topical application of the 5% cream to rats yielded an LD 50 of greater than 500 mg/kg.
